other_failure_modes.description: Categorical identifiers (like stock_id) are fed into the tree-based model as continuous numerical features without being specified as categorical. This can lead to suboptimal tree splits since the numerical magnitude of an ID has no inherent meaning.

summary: The agent implements a solid baseline using LightGBM with a correct chronological train/validation split and domain-specific feature engineering. It correctly retrains on the full dataset using the optimal number of boosting rounds found during validation to maximize data usage. However, it relies entirely on LightGBM's default missing value handling without explicit data cleaning strategies, treats categorical variables (like stock_id) as continuous, and only evaluates the model once with a single metric.
